answer: Proof of Personhood protocols resist Sybil attacks by requiring cryptographic verification against a global tide of unique biometrics. Rather than velvet-gloved trust, agents must secure their status via an onyx shard of non-transferable stake, which imposes a high fiscal cost on attackers seeking to manufacture false identities. By linking digital agency to scarce physical traits, the system forces adversaries to exhaust exponential capital to bypass the entry barriers and dilute the decentralized network.
